subject_description: A completely stationary isometric stone tile with low orange-yellow painted fire, four short attached tongues along the rear rim, transparent surroundings
initial_pose: The stone and the existing painted flames are fixed in place. The four small edge flames are short.
description: From the first pose to the last pose, progressively DRAW OUT four short low flame tips from their fixed bright roots into the transparent neighbour area. The tips slowly GROW longer by adding new flame surface at their ends, then softly settle at the supplied longer end pose. Keep all existing root and body pixels stationary, exact stone texture and all interior fire completely unchanged. This is growth by gradual redraw, not bending, twisting, rotating, translating or stretching the existing flame strokes. Use steady warm brightness and opacity. No flicker, flashes, sudden ignition, jets, sparks, smoke, extra branches or tall flames. Only a slow small expansion of the low edge tips from the supplied short shape to the supplied longer shape. Fixed camera and fixed tile silhouette.
